 Logistics coordinator 
Michael Page · Standplaats: Rotterdam · 11 september 2026 
As Logistics Coordinator, you are responsible for managing international shipments from order to delivery, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency throughout the process. You work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and logistics partners to support critical global operations. 
About the Company 
Our client is a fast-paced, international technology company based in the Rotterdam area. The organization provides advanced connectivity solutions that ensure reliable communication in environments where failure is not an option, including ships at sea, remote installations, and high-security operations. The company culture combines technical excellence with collaboration, continuous improvement and a strong sense of mission. English is the working language, and colleagues come from all over the world. 
Description 
The Role - Logistics Coordinator 
As Logistics Coordinator, you'll be responsible for organizing and executing international shipments, coordinating with suppliers, internal teams and customers. You'll handle both the administrative and operational aspects of logistics: arranging transport, managing returns, processing orders, and ensuring customs compliance. You'll work with modern ERP systems, support internal projects, and help improve processes. You'll also take part in the team's shared duty phone rotation. 
Profile

Grace Church Amsterdam is an English speaking Christian church serving an international community in Amsterdam. We are seeking a full time Lead Pastor and Lead Elder to provide pastoral, theological and organizational leadership to the church.

The Lead Pastor will serve as a Staff Elder and work together with our lay elders. Responsibilities include preaching regularly, overseeing Sunday worship gatherings, leading elder meetings, providing pastoral care, equipping church members for discipleship and evangelism, developing future elders and deacons, supervising staff, and overseeing the day to day operations of the church.

The candidate must be able to affirm the doctrinal statement of Grace Church without reservation. We are seeking a pastor committed to expository preaching, the authority and inerrancy of Scripture, complementarian convictions, and Reformed soteriology.

Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required. The candidate must be able to preach, teach, provide pastoral care, lead meetings, and supervise staff in an English speaking church environment.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter explaining their relevant ministry experience and interest in serving Grace Church Amsterdam.
